tasks.query: synchronously write a newline then indentation characters for the current nesting depth, reusing a cached buffer of indent chars emitted in chunks
tasks.note: JsonTextWriter.WriteIndent computes depth times indent size and writes a newline plus indent characters from a cached char buffer in chunks, while the JsonWriter base version is empty.

tasks.query: try to parse a string into a DateTime by choosing between Microsoft-style date literals, ISO 8601 text or a custom exact format string
tasks.note: DateTimeUtils.TryParseDateTime inspects the text and dispatches to the Microsoft date, ISO or exact-format parsers, with StringReference and string overloads.

tasks.query: write grouped XML nodes sharing an element name as one JSON array, but a lone node plainly unless it is flagged as an array
tasks.note: XmlNodeConverter.WriteGroupedNodes emits either the single node itself or a property name plus a JSON array of the grouped nodes, in list and single-node overloads.

tasks.query: populate a multidimensional array from nested JSON arrays, using a stack of lists per dimension until the innermost rank is reached
tasks.note: JsonSerializerInternalReader.PopulateMultidimensionalArray reads nested arrays into a stack of lists until the array rank is reached, deserializing items at the innermost level.

tasks.query: process the additionalProperties keyword of a JSON schema: a boolean sets whether extra properties are allowed, anything else is built as a nested schema
tasks.note: JsonSchemaBuilder.ProcessAdditionalProperties stores a boolean token as AllowAdditionalProperties and otherwise builds a nested schema into AdditionalProperties.

tasks.query: per-type serialization metadata lookup cached in a static copy-on-write dictionary shared by all instances and keyed by concrete class plus target type
tasks.note: CamelCasePropertyNamesContractResolver.ResolveContract overrides the base lookup with a static copy-on-write cache keyed by resolver type and object type, guarded by a lock.

tasks.query: emit an instant as an integer count of seconds since the start of 1970, rejecting earlier ones unless a flag permits it
tasks.note: UnixDateTimeConverter.WriteJson converts a DateTime or DateTimeOffset to whole seconds since the Unix epoch, throws for other values, and rejects pre-epoch dates unless AllowPreEpoch is set.

tasks.query: iterate a list using optional start, end and stride where negative bounds count from the back, with backward defaults, throwing on a zero stride
tasks.note: ArraySliceFilter.ExecuteFilter implements the [start:end:step] JSONPath slice with negative index handling, default bounds depending on step sign and a zero-step error.

tasks.query: pick the public single-parameter creator of a container type that accepts a sequence of its elements, preferring an exact generic match over an assignable one
tasks.note: CollectionUtils.ResolveEnumerableCollectionConstructor scans public constructors for one taking IEnumerable of the item type, falling back to the first parameter assignable from IList of the item type.

tasks.query: task-returning factory building the matching LINQ-to-JSON node (object, array, constructor, property or primitive) for the stream's current element, honoring comment and line-info settings
tasks.note: JToken.ReadFromAsync awaits the first token if needed, then loads a JObject, JArray, JConstructor, JProperty or creates a JValue with line info depending on the current token type.

tasks.query: merge one JSON document into another: object properties merge recursively honoring null and name-comparison options, while arrays are concatenated, unioned, replaced or merged by index
tasks.note: JObject.MergeItem merges properties recursively with null and comparison settings, and JContainer.MergeEnumerableContent applies the Concat, Union, Replace or Merge array handling mode.

tasks.query: how member names become lowerCamelCase in serialized JSON: explicitly specified names stay unless overriding is enabled, and a leading run of capital letters is lowercased
tasks.note: NamingStrategy.GetPropertyName skips explicit names unless OverrideSpecifiedNames, CamelCaseNamingStrategy.ResolvePropertyName delegates to StringUtils.ToCamelCase which lowercases the leading capitals.

tasks.query: asynchronously write a LINQ-to-JSON object: start marker, each property's name then its value with primitives dispatched by kind, then the end marker
tasks.note: JObject.WriteToAsync writes the start object, awaits each child property's WriteToAsync and the end object; JProperty.WriteToAsync writes the name then the value; JValue.WriteToAsync switches on the value type to the matching writer call.

tasks.query: when the outermost BSON object or array is closed, where is the buffered document tree measured and then written out to the stream
tasks.note: BsonWriter.WriteEnd hands the root token to BsonBinaryWriter.WriteToken when the stack empties, and WriteToken calls CalculateSize before serializing the tree.

tasks.query: trace object-to-JSON-string conversion: the static helper, the serializer applying its settings to the writer, and the internal writer walking the object graph
tasks.note: JsonConvert.SerializeObject builds a serializer and string writer, JsonSerializer.SerializeInternal applies settings to the writer and restores them, JsonSerializerInternalWriter.Serialize walks the value with error handling.
